sections.title: Video Player Interface and Thank You Message
sections.summary: The section describes a video player interface with a thank you message displayed on top, inviting viewers to subscribe to the channel.
sections.visual_cues: Video player interface with slides, thumbnail of a video, progress bar, speaker icon, and red subscribe button. Black background with white text and icons.
sections.verbal_cues: THANKS FOR WATCHING, SUBSCRIBE TO MY CHANNEL, PATREON SUBSCRIBE
